Hi Marissa,

The field teams showed me two different behaviors in staging:

Kate — thanks for raising this. Short answer: Order Forms can bind commercial terms for a purchase provided they are executed by an authorized signer per the signer authority on file; however the MSA signature level establishes the contract backbone and some enterprise customers require officer-level MSA signoff for legal acceptance.

We don't have a single yes/no across every buyer portal because many marketplaces (Coupa/Ariba) allow delegated acceptance; what matters to our legal ops and billing:

- We must have a signer-authority artefact on record for the account (Signer Matrix or delegation letter).
- PO-ack behavior is governed by account-level configuration — e.g., whether Coupa sends an EDI 855 (PO Acknowledgement) and whether Redwood treats an EDI 855 as an acceptance event for billing.
- If the buyer requires officer signature on the MSA, we mark the MSA as "enterprise-signed" in our portal and route future Order Forms to require signer verification.

I've attached a redline and a proposed signer matrix template for StellarHealth. Kimberly — can you confirm the minimum acceptable evidence for delegation (POA/board resolution/authorized signatory PDF) and whether we should refuse portal activation until we have that? Jonas — can you confirm which Coupa flow toggles the EDI 855 behavior for pilot accounts?

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly confirms evidence list;
2) Kate uploads signer matrix (or scans of delegation) into the Coupa account and shares link;
3) Jonas verifies pilot tenant EDI settings and confirms PO-ack mapping to our billing trigger;
4) We hold a 20-min call if any item is a gap.

Thanks — attaching: MSA_redline_v3.docx (redline), Signer_Authority_Matrix.xlsx (template).

Thanks Marissa. For our legal/compliance stance — internal note below for the record and for auditors: we accept one of the following as evidence of signer delegation for Order Forms/PO acceptance in a buyer portal. Please upload one of these and we will seal to the account record (Coupa profile or our KYC folder):

1) Signed Signer Authority Matrix (recommended): table showing names, titles, email addresses, signature sample, and effective dates.
2) Board resolution or corporate minute delegating signing authority (required for officer-level exceptions).
3) Power of attorney or specific delegation letter on company letterhead, signed by an authorized officer.
4) Verified e-sign certificate trace (DocuSign certificate for the executed MSA + order form) when the portal flow supports it.

Operational requirements:
- If an enterprise buyer requires an officer-signed MSA, we should not treat a portal PO acceptance by a delegated agent as binding for legal acceptance unless the delegation artefact (1–3) is on file.
- For pilot accounts where delegation artefact is provided, we will enable the Coupa EDI 855 -> Redwood PO-ack mapping so that an 855 can trigger our billing workflow; otherwise we fallback to manual verification and the PO must be paired with an executed Order Form PDF.

I attached an internal PO_Ack_Playbook.pdf that documents the EDI mapping toggles and the checklist our ops team uses when onboarding a new procurement tenant. Jonas please confirm the toggle names (tenant settings) so I can add exact UI paths to the playbook.
